note: Light modifiers (what goes on the light). Labels follow the source image; 'A parable' there reads as parabolic.

items.name: Reflection umbrella
items.description: Black-backed umbrella with a white interior; light bounces off the inside. Cheap, fast, broad and fairly soft, spills everywhere.
items.prompt: soft broad bounced light from a large white umbrella, even fill, gentle falloff, slight spill

items.name: Octabox
items.description: Eight-sided softbox. Soft light with round catchlights, a classic for portraits.
items.prompt: large octagonal softbox key light, soft wrapping light, round catchlights in the eyes

items.name: Parabolic softbox
items.description: Deep parabolic dish with a diffuser. Soft but more controlled and punchy than a flat softbox, with contrasty modelling.
items.prompt: deep parabolic softbox, soft yet directional light, crisp shadow edge with gentle transition, high-end portrait look

items.name: Softbox
items.description: Rectangular box with a diffusion front. The standard soft key/fill: wraps around the subject, shadow edges are soft.
items.prompt: soft rectangular softbox key light, smooth skin-flattering light, soft shadow edges

items.name: Strip box
items.description: Tall narrow softbox (image says 'comic strip'). Gives long thin highlights; used for rim, edge and separation light.
items.prompt: strip softbox rim light from behind, thin bright edge highlight along the silhouette, dark background

items.name: Lightdome
items.description: Large dome-shaped soft modifier. Very even, enveloping light with little shadow.
items.prompt: large lightdome, very even wraparound soft light, minimal shadows, clean studio look

items.name: China ball
items.description: Round paper/fabric lantern. Omnidirectional soft glow, great for practical-looking ambient light over a set or table.
items.prompt: warm glowing paper lantern overhead, soft omnidirectional ambient light, natural practical look

items.name: Spotlight reflector
items.description: Standard metal reflector (image says 'spotlight'). Hard, punchy, directional light with defined shadows.
items.prompt: hard directional light, sharp defined shadows, high contrast, strong highlights

items.name: Fresnel lens
items.description: Stepped-glass lens on a studio or cine light. Adjustable spot-to-flood beam, hard light with a soft-edged falloff, the cinema classic.
items.prompt: fresnel spotlight, hard cinematic key light with a soft beam edge, strong directional shadows

items.name: Spot projector
items.description: Optical spotlight attachment (image says 'spotted'). Projects a sharp-edged beam and can carry gobos/cut-outs to throw shapes.
items.prompt: sharp-edged projected spot of light, gobo pattern shadows on the wall, theatrical focused beam

items.name: Telezoom reflector
items.description: Long narrow-beam reflector. Hard light that carries a distance with a tight, controllable cone.
items.prompt: narrow tight beam of hard light, strong localised pool of light, dark surroundings

items.name: Snoot / honeycomb tube
items.description: Conical tube or grid cone (image says 'teat/tube'). Narrows light to a small tight circle; used for hair, accent and highlight spots.
items.prompt: tightly controlled small circle of light, snoot accent light on hair and face, deep shadows around

items.name: Beauty dish
items.description: Shallow dish with a centre deflector. Crisp yet soft: contrasty, sculpting light with defined cheekbones; fashion and beauty staple.
items.prompt: beauty dish key light from above-front, sculpted cheekbones, crisp but flattering light, fashion beauty portrait
